datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2018 and spatially mapped to administrative units in Uganda. The dataset contains near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases (IPC classifications) across multiple scenarios, representing the food security impact of underlying hazards such as drought.
